integrity: Two independently constructed standalone programs reproduce the complete 3872-state exchange graph metric and the 240-pair six-cycle classification; no independent scholarly audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite statement only for the sixteen-vertex five-regular Clebsch graph; published novelty cannot be guaranteed from incomplete historical access. Preexisting minimum-set number, coefficient 3872, and seven orbit types are not new contributions.
title: The 240-pair six-cycle geodesic defect in the Clebsch zero-forcing exchange graph
